name: Eco Basket V1
summary: A source-only multi-pool Uniswap v4 hook that collects bounded exact-input output fees into isolated pool vaults for later basket, buyback, and liquidity accounting.

integration.standardSwapBehavior: Prepared native-quote pools support both exact-input directions with empty hook data. The hook takes a preset fee from the unspecified output currency. Both exact-output directions fail closed because Hookr PR 3 does not publish a gross-up router or quote ABI.

dedicatedRouter.purpose: No Hookr router ABI is assumed. Local PoolManager evidence uses the pinned PoolSwapTest fixture and does not infer payer, recipient, or user identity from callback sender.

hookData.emptyDataBehavior: Empty and non-empty hook data are ignored. Configuration comes only from prepared immutable PoolId state.

officialUniversalRouter.notes: No deployed Universal Router identity, runtime hash, or final wallet evidence is supplied.

multihop.notes: No multihop route is claimed because exact-output swaps are rejected and no public Hookr route ABI is available.

quoteDiscovery.notes: The source-only release does not publish a quoter and does not claim ALF compatibility.

finalAmountEvidence.notes: The pinned PoolManager tests prove that each exact-input final output equals the pool output less the returned afterSwap fee delta.

dependencies.name: Hookr external-hook V2 review flow
dependencies.notes: Only the schema, policy, and semantic validator published at Hookr PR 3 head 2b0ee64ed85a2d47037efebb8de144cafa23054e are used.

dependencies.name: Eco approved executor
dependencies.notes: One immutable product-owned address receives only recorded buyback, liquidity, and due scheduled-order funds. It is a trusted custody boundary, not a Hookr ABI.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeInitialize
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the callback to the immutable PoolManager. The registry accepts activation only from its immutable hook address and consumes one prepared PoolId atomically.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: One registry read and write with no loop. Basket validation and vault creation occur during the earlier adapter preparation call, not in this callback.

callbackSemantics.name: afterSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the callback to the immutable PoolManager. The hook reads one active PoolId, takes one output currency amount to that pool vault, and calls the hook-only vault accounting entry point.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: The callback has no loop. It performs one registry read, one PoolManager take, and one bounded vault allocation update. External basket trades, buybacks, liquidity changes, and order creation are excluded.

security.authorityModel: The hook, registry, vaults, and order hub are non-upgradeable. One immutable approved adapter can prepare each PoolId once. PoolManager-only initialization activates and freezes that configuration. One immutable product-owned executor can schedule orders and receive only recorded or due funds. It cannot select another recipient. There is no owner or mutable allowlist.
knownRisks: This is unaudited source-only code and is not approved for production deployment.
Exact-output swaps are intentionally unsupported until Hookr publishes a router, quoter, and prefund contract that can gross up the output safely.
Exact-input buys collect their fee in strategy-token output, so the recorded basket amount is not a native quote budget.
The immutable approved executor is a trusted custody and off-chain product boundary after bounded funds leave a vault.
This source does not execute external token trades, buybacks, or liquidity operations and does not define executor routing behavior.
No native-block composition or Hookr launch ABI compatibility is claimed.
